name: Seraphic Bastion Servitor
loreTies: A shield servant built around protection rites, deployed to preserve Empyrean order during Gate events.
Protects ranged units and counters reckless cleaves.
source culture humans later copied as angelic and heavenly lore
shortBackstory: Seraphic Bastion Servitor is a lore-faithful Empyrean run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Seraphic Bastion Servitor belongs to The Radiant Hierarchies and exists to express Empyrean law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Protects ranged units and counters reckless cleaves.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: White-gold shield construct with folded wing plates, opal joints, low-burning aura engine. Abilities — Bastion Wing, Sanction Shield, Order Pulse — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.
